_source: County centroids computed from the US Census Bureau cartographic county boundaries (plotly/datasets geojson-counties-fips.json, 3,221 county FIPS ids, 2010 vintage): area-weighted centroid of each county's polygons, latitude and longitude rounded to 3 decimals. Key: 5-digit county FIPS (state + county). Used to place county-level weather alerts (lib/signals/adapters/nws.ts). Not a Gazetteer internal point: for a very irregular county it can sit a few miles from it.
